Both returnflags false; prepared bytes remain debited, not retried. A prepared empty payload would use0 andSHA256(empty), distinct from unprepared0/null; generated journal/publish packets are nonempty.

journal_close_rule: Set journal.closed=True when its one-shot close reservation is consumed BEFORE dispatch; fromthenon append/reopen/retry forbidden even ifcallbackunreturned ordispatchblocked. outputs.journal_close.attempted separately records actualcallbackdispatch; unknown/false close keepsACKFalse and tipnull. No reopen to improve evidence.
journal_serialization: Prepare immutable UTF8 JSON row bytes BEFORE append dispatch, sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False, exactlyoneLF, <=1024B. Serialized row has ONLY serialized_journal_row keys: NO own return_observed/acknowledged/state fields. journal.events are separate registry-only append observations and may later gain ack facts; their updates do not rewrite stored bytes or self-certify a durable append. No tip/ack hash cycle.
lifecycle: Bind the non-owning view/sink/compiler/hooks, then admit full metadata plan BEFORE reserve_output/open. Capture early, issue token, claim once to a Continuation, load the marker entry through the same loader, then call continue_once on that ALREADY-CLAIMED view. continue_once enters once and owns finally/finalize. On a bootstrap failure before continue_once, its caller invokes owner.finalize once. Baseline never finalizes a second time. External finalize accepts ONLY the literal string incomplete. The normal controller derives consistent/negative from the accepted same-owner gates/verdicts and invokes its one terminal sequence internally; public callers cannot provide a ready/consistent/negative outcome.
observation_protocol: Snapshot.to_dict returns ordinary detached containers plus stable source-issued opaque identity tokens in diagnostics; no live mutable record or exception object leaf. File/Call refs are accepted only by current owner. Harness normalizes opaque tokens for JSON comparison separately and checks original object identities externally.
packet_rules: Encode only the closed ELEVEN-key compact packet as UTF8 JSON(sortkeys,compactseparators,ensure_ascii,allow_nanFalse)+oneLF. Enforce<=8192 BEFORE callback. Never serialize the full21call ledger, original path strings, diagnostics or live objects. Links may reference only earlier known acknowledged artifacts/tip; never currentpayload/selfhash. Candidate has no selfcandidate link; cleanup has no selfcleanup link; seal includes priorreceipt but no selfseal link. Receipt/seal observations are registry-only afterjournalclose. Harness independently checks actualpayloadlen/hash against callbackmetadata and compactshapes/IDs/links; no exactliteralpacket hash or realpacket-format qualification is inferred.

read_only_ref_surface.rule: All listed properties are read-only. Actual identity is opaque and externally compared with is; no public mutable record dictionaries. FileRecordRef.spec is the canonical immutable FileSpec; CallRef.file_ref is the SAME current canonical ref; BufferRef refers to the one owner buffer, not a copy. Only the owner can modify backing state.

strict_numeric_domains.bounds: file IDs0..N-1; call ordinals0..C-1; eventsequence0..E-1; nextsequence0..E; filecounts nonnegative<=fieldplannedbound; bytes nonnegative<=their declared pool. Aggregate reserved capacities C/E are not actualcounts. Per-API invocation/scalar/wrapper/count axes never exceed created applicable records.
strict_numeric_domains.integers: Every counter/ID/ordinal/length/capacity/sequence/size/schema-version field requires exact int, NEVER bool, float or coercion. Enforce the field cap with integer comparisons before allocation/dispatch; malformed/oversized values do not overflow via float conversion.
strict_numeric_domains.other: Flags require exactbool. Atoms enforce uint64 HANDLE/uint32 DWORD+COUNT/signed32 BOOL with rawvalues retained; no truthiness coercion. Strings/hex/digests retain their explicit bounded domains.
strict_numeric_domains.times: Time fields require exact int or finite float, NEVER bool/NaN/infinity; compare without unnecessary integer-to-float coercion. Original now is monotonic. Endpoints are originalstart+295/+300. Reporting snapshots do not sample clocks; invalidclock retains lastknownsample and cannot yield completion.

terminal_semantics: An in-flight error AFTER seal ACK but BEFORE finalclock/result vetoes completion, records immutable primary/secondary and causes no postseal I/O. AFTER a frozen final result has returned, foreign/repeated/second-finalize/close/work attempts raise SharedOwnerError(FINALIZED_MISUSE) BEFORE clock/error/counter/event mutation or I/O. The cached issued result/snapshot remains unchanged; no new session invalidates it.

test_seams.clock: Clock is a monotonic stateful synthetic callable; literal steps may change its value or raise at a generic hook/binding point. Do NOT prescribe no-op sample counts. All required checks still sample it. Snapshot/to_dict never sample or advance the clock. Time fields are seconds; work/hard ends are original start+295/+300, not absolute0/295/300.
test_seams.close: Only owner.finalize enumerates cleanup. view.close is the single central close primitive and may be driven directly by a negative lifetime fixture; it does not create another cleanup owner/list. A prematurely closed early lease then blocks handoff/load/cache-return.
test_seams.compiler: compiler(fullname, exact_captured_bytes, resolver). No ordinary import/cache/path fallback. Loading cohort_entry attempts entry then leaf and returns leaf then entry. Marker functions are not authority/checker factories.
test_seams.factories: Both callbacks are zero-argument trusted harness functions. Wrapped factories/returned TestAuthority/TestCheckerPorts are explicitly SYNTHETIC_ONLY and bound to owner/nonce. Handlers take exact EvidenceContext and return TestObservation. ids order is archive/journal/resources/core. No production factory/checker constructor exists.
test_seams.forged_caps: admit_plan has ONLY its three positional parameters and no claimed_C/E input. Wrong full_specs dictionary or unexpected keyword is a type/interface refusal; an unentered Python TypeError does not fabricate owner primary/attempt/output evidence. Literal expectations independently assert derived C/E.
test_seams.hooks: TestHooks(owner, callback); callback(point, owner, call_ref_or_None) has EXACT points hash_update/copy_bytes/before_final_ack. Return value ignored. hash_update/copy_bytes run immediately BEFORE their real commit: a hash fault has knownN/hash0/capture0; a copy fault has knownN/hashN/capture0. before_final_ack runs after seal ACK retention, before final clock/result; its errors/illegal dispatches are in-flight vetoes.
